title: The September Sitting is open
dek: Thirty painted dog portraits, one for every September day, now sitting at /kennel-club. Flat acrylic color, a screenprint accent, a name and a breed for each. The open edition mint is live at 1 ꜩ per sitting.
body:
Thirty portraits. Thirty September dates. One dog keeps the chair every day.

Kennel Club begins with the first two sittings already on the calendar, then continues one plate at a time through the end of the month. Each portrait has its own name, breed, room, and place in the sequence. The calendar is the edition list.

Start with today's sitting, then take the whole month in order. Nothing is hidden behind a feed: every dog has a date, a plate, and a permanent place in the record. There is a plain-text sheet at /send/kennel-club you can text to one person. The mint is live at 1 ꜩ per sitting.
